sentences.text: This petition under Section 407 r/w Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed for seeking transfer of Criminal Case - RCT No.1620/2018 under Sections 498A, 406, 406 of IPC and Sections 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, from Katni to Sagar.
2. However, as prayed by learned counsel for the petitioner, this petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to give evidence through Video Conferencing from District Court, Sagar.
3. With the aforesaid liberty, this petition stands disposed of.

(B. P. SHARMA) JUDGE ac/-
